purpose: Transaction-level reference for the blocking L1 caches: architectural data, hit/miss classification, replacement and downstream line traffic. It has no timing, races or pipeline state; RTL scoreboards compare its outcomes, not its cycles.
geometry_status: provisional until the storage-feasibility pilot and geometry ADR
semantics_rule: The semantics values are binding and validated by model/cache.py. A different value is a different contract and must change the model and its tests.
access_rule: Accesses are 1, 2 or 4 bytes, naturally aligned, so none crosses a line. Misalignment and uncached/MMIO classification are trapped or routed before the cache. A store miss fills before writing; a fill error is reported to the access and nothing is written. Committed-store admission must complete that fill before retirement (config/committed_store.json).
permission_rule: writable is a required boolean. configured() builds the cache with it, so a store to the read-only I$ fails.
flush_rule: flush() writes back every dirty line in set then way order and invalidates nothing; it is the end-of-test and D-side clean reference, not a FENCE.I policy decision.
